domain: ICES SD 22-32 (commercial); Baltic coastal sub-basins (coastal). SD 21 Kattegat and the Kattegat coastal water bodies are excluded as outside the model domain.
ges_boundary_note: External HELCOM convention (BQR/EQR >= 0.6 = Good Environmental Status). NOT a field returned by the service; sourced from the HOLAS 3 narrative reports.
confidence_note: Layer 434 returned Confidence = 0 for every SD in this vintage; the field carries no per-SD signal and is not stored.
guild_note: Commercial layer 434 resolves only two buckets, DEM (demersal) and PEL (pelagic) - no per-species value. Coastal layer 417 is an aggregated 'Integrated abundance coastal fish species' EQR per sub-basin - no per-species value either. smelt + stickleback are in neither indicator (forage). The mapping records intent; HOLAS 3 cannot score any single species.

domain_summary.verdict: Whole model domain is sub-GES for commercial fish (both guilds well below the 0.6 boundary). The only SD reaching GES is SD 31 (pelagic, Bothnian Bay). This leaves HOLAS 3 with no discriminating signal across the domain - the reason a quantitative HOLAS 3 validator was not built. See docs/baltic_holas3_diagnostic_2026-06-04.md.
